# Generation 7 — Tiferes Execution Plan

The Awtsmoos joins discovery and action until every path can sing;
Awtsmoos.com will bind comment truth and custom-domain identity at the shared rendering spring.

## Phase A — Comments

1. Read `publicCommentResolver.js`, `commentPage.js`, sitemap data, and rich-comment storage paths.
2. Reproduce one failing maamar_shorts comment against canonical DosDB locally.
3. Determine why sitemap resolution succeeds while production route returns 404.
4. Rewrite the smallest shared source(s) so sitemap and renderer share one live-comment contract.
5. Add focused regression for the discovered storage shape.
6. Start clean runtime with canonical DB and prove all 19 previously failing URLs return 200 indexable HTML.
7. Run comments sitemap audit and full SEO/runtime tests.

## Phase B — Hosted/custom-domain SEO

1. Resolve actual host-routing/published-site files from archaeology output.
2. Read entire candidate source files and line counts before changes.
3. Identify final HTML response boundary and project/domain metadata available there.
4. Design tiny modules: trusted public origin, page metadata, HTML semantic enrichment, robots/sitemap adapter if route inventory exists.
5. Preserve authored tags and inject only missing safe defaults.
6. Ensure custom-domain requests canonicalize to the verified public domain.
7. Ensure private/preview surfaces default noindex.
8. Add focused unit/integration tests for Awtsmoos host + custom DNS + authored overrides + malicious host.
9. Run static/source-law/tunnel-release tests.

## Phase C — Integration and deployment

1. Fetch latest origin/main and audit overlap.
2. Move only verified changes onto newest clean lineage.
3. Run complete clean release candidate gates.
4. Runtime-test canonical DB and synthetic/custom-host requests.
5. Run local sitemap crawl until zero blocking errors/advisories.
6. Stage exact files, guarded prepare, push, exact-SHA activate.
7. Publicly verify all 19 comment URLs and representative custom-domain/public-site SEO behavior that is reachable from available domain fixtures.
8. Run public crawl again.
9. Write planned-vs-actual, evidence, remaining-work closure.
